exact_name_records.exact_quote_or_snippet:
Apply for or Manage Building Permits (iBuild)

The City of Miami Building Department offers a comprehensive online platform for managing building permits called iBuild. Our user-friendly system is designed to streamline your permit application process from the comfort of your home or office. Whether you are looking to apply for a new permit, manage existing ones, or make changes, iBuild offers an intuitive interface that simplifies navigation and expedites the process. Equipped with resources to guide you at every step, iBuild ensures a smoother, more efficient permitting experience.

Supporting current forms/process page: https://www.miami.gov/Permits-Construction/Digital-Permitting/Permitting-Forms-Documents
Permitting Forms & Documents
IMPORTANT: THE DOCUMENTS ON THIS PAGE CANNOT BE USED TO BEGIN A PERMIT APPLICATION. If you are looking to begin a permit application, please visit our Permits & Construction page or refer to our Guide to Getting a Permit for more information. All new permit applications must be completed digitally through our online permitting system. Building Permit Forms ... All permit applications must be started electronically in iBuild or ePlan. Building Permit Forms list includes Tenant Improvement Hold Harmless And Indemnification Agreement.
